description: Source code for Windows-specific UDP socket implementation in Chromium project, including socket management, overlapped I/O, QoS handling, and network event processing.

classes.name: UDPSocketWin::Core
classes.description: Manages asynchronous overlapped I/O operations for UDP socket, including read/write buffers and event watchers.

classes.name: QwaveApi
classes.description: Encapsulates Windows QOS API functions for network flow management.

classes.name: DscpManager
classes.description: Manages Differentiated Services Code Point (DSCP) settings and QoS flows for a socket.

methods.name: UDPSocketWin::Core::WatchForRead
methods.description: Starts watching for read completion events.

methods.name: UDPSocketWin::Core::WatchForWrite
methods.description: Starts watching for write completion events.

methods.name: UDPSocketWin::Core::ReadDelegate::OnObjectSignaled
methods.description: Callback invoked when read event is signaled, triggers completion handling.

methods.name: UDPSocketWin::Core::WriteDelegate::OnObjectSignaled
methods.description: Callback invoked when write event is signaled, triggers completion handling.

methods.name: DscpManager::Set
methods.description: Sets the DSCP value and manages QoS flows accordingly.

methods.name: DscpManager::PrepareForSend
methods.description: Prepares QoS flow for sending data to a specific remote address.
